props.gloss_en: Rav Beivai bar Abaye: all year a person may pray 'havinenu', except in the rainy season
because one must say the request [for rain] in the blessing of the years
[including the request for rain within havinenu] would confuse him
Rav Asi: one who erred and omitted the request [for rain] in the blessing of the years is not sent back
because he can say it in 'who hears prayer'

answered_by.gloss_en: טעה שאני -- one who erred is different [the memra speaks only of one who erred]
